market_summary: US stocks sold off hard on Fri Nov 20: Nasdaq down about 3-3.6% and into correction, the chip index down about 7%, with AMD, Broadcom, Micron and Marvell all down 8-11%. Triggers were an Anthropic IPO 'sell the news' reversal, a report that Google cut 2027 Broadcom TPU orders for MediaTek, and TSMC tightening AI chip curbs for some Chinese designers. Treasuries rallied as a haven, the 10-year back near 4.95-4.98% from 5.17% earlier in the week. The Fed is priced for a hike, not a cut, on Dec 9: about 90% for 25bp and 10% for 50bp after Waller said policy 'may have to shock people'; Waller's Nov 20 welcome remarks gave no new guidance and Cook's Santiago speech coverage was not found. Asia was hit too (Taiwan -6.6%, Nikkei -4.8%); the UMich final reading was not confirmed (prelim 51.0, 1-yr inflation expectations 4.3%).

AMZN.reason: Down ~3% with megacaps; no company news, AWS thesis intact.

AXOS.reason: Down under 1%; forward PE ~8.6, little AI exposure.

BABA.reason: Down ~1%; low forward PE ~10, cloud thesis unchanged.

ENPH.reason: Down ~8% with no specific news found; rate-hike pricing hurts residential solar.

FIGR.reason: Down ~8% alongside crypto as Bitcoin broke below $60k.

GOOGL.reason: Flat in a 3.6% Nasdaq drop; Anthropic stake now marked to market, cheapest megacap holding.

LDI.reason: Down ~7%, listing-compliance risk and no forward earnings; weakest position.

META.reason: Down ~5% on AI capex fears; no company-specific news.

MRVL.reason: Down 10% after this week's downgrade; weakest chip name held, wait for stabilisation.

MU.reason: Fell 13%, about 22% over five sessions; memory cycle intact, forward PE ~3.4. Don't sell into panic.

NFLX.reason: Down ~2%, little AI exposure; acts as relative ballast.

NVDA.reason: Down 7% to a 52-week low on CEO exit and a China-export subpoena; forward PE ~9 already prices fear.

RKT.reason: Up ~3% as 10yr yield dipped under 5%; a rare green holding.

TSM.reason: Down 8.5% as Taiex lost ~15% this week; foundry monopoly unchanged.

STRIPE.reason: No new round or tender reported; mark unchanged.

OPENAI.reason: No new round found; last tender Aug at $852B. Anthropic's 12% day-two drop is a public comp to watch.

headlines: S&P 500 fell about 2.2% Fri, seventh straight loss; S&P and Dow now in correction, Nasdaq negative for 2026.
Chip rout deepened: MU -13%, MRVL -10%, TSM -8.5%, NVDA -7% to a 52-week low.
Fed now priced for a December hike, about 90% odds of 25bp; 10yr eased under 5%.
Anthropic gave back about 12% on day two but stayed above its $83 IPO price.
GPU rental rates held flat while AI stocks fell: H100 $3.11/hr, B200 $6.94/hr.
Next: HPE earnings Mon after close (Tue 9am AEDT); US GDP and PCE Thu 12:30am AEDT.
